content.short: Chronicle Protocol provides decentralized oracle infrastructure for verifiable data delivery and lower cost updates across chains.
content.description: Chronicle Protocol is an oracle network built to deliver blockchain data feeds with a stronger focus on transparency, verifiability, and gas efficiency. Its official materials center on Scribe, the protocol's oracle design, along with validator based consensus and tooling that lets builders trace data from publication through onchain delivery. Chronicle grew out of MakerDAO's oracle work and is now positioned as a blockchain agnostic data layer for DeFi and other applications. On Mantle, it fits as shared price and data infrastructure for teams that need secure external inputs.
